# HELPER FUNCTIONS

[esc](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:esc)
makes text safe to show on a page                        

[msg](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:msg)
shows one line when there is nothing to read              
        
[drawer](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:drawer)
opens and hides the tree on a narrow screen

[loadMaps](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:loadMaps)
reads the records of every file and human file in one ask, or gives empty ones

[held](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:held)
gives a record, or an empty one when it holds no abstractions

[fromMaps](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:fromMaps)
takes the record of one file or human file out of maps

[humanPath](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:humanPath)
names the record of a human file
                
[bareOf](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:bareOf)
gives the bare name of a human path

[shownPath](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:shownPath)
gives the name a human file wears in the tree

[recordPath](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:recordPath)
gives the record behind a shown name

     says a file has no code under it           ([noCodeFile](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:noCodeFile))
     asks for human.json, or gives nothing when it did not change  ([loadList](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:loadList))
     builds the file tree for one project         ([buildTree](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:buildTree))
     names the record the server keeps for a file   ([mapName](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:mapName))
     shuts the box for the name of a new file       ([newClose](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:newClose))
             
[treeLast](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:treeLast)
finds the row above the empty space you clicked 

[treeRoots](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:treeRoots)
finds the roots the tree draws in            

[treeRows](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:treeRows)
gives every row of the tree                   

[newOpen](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:newOpen)
opens that box under a row, empty, and keeps that row's folder for the enter

     finds the tree row you right clicked            ([treeRow](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:treeRow))
     gives the folder that row stands in             ([treeDir](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:treeDir))
     asks for the file when you open it             ([loadCode](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:loadCode))
     finds a file of the project by name                ([fileOf](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:fileOf))
     says if a piece has an abstraction         ([crossEntry](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:crossEntry))
     says if an abstraction has those words   ([crossAnchor](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:crossAnchor))
     finds which abstraction a pin points at        ([targetOf](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:targetOf))
     reads a pin the map does not hold    ([guessAnchor](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:guessAnchor))
     finds the pin behind one bracket                     ([pinOf](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:pinOf))
     says what a muted pin shows beside it          ([suffixOf](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:suffixOf))
     turns the pins of one line into links          ([lineHtml](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:lineHtml))
     says if the tip is for the open file            ([tipHere](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:tipHere))
     says if a line holds the words the tip points at  ([tipLine](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:tipLine))
     finds the first line of words the tip points at  ([tipFirst](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:tipFirst))
     says the name the server knows a file by       ([nameOf](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:nameOf))
     names where your typed words are held           ([key](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:key))
     gives the text a box opens with            ([baseText](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:baseText))
     says if a place for words is open here      ([expandHere](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:expandHere))
     says if a delete is asked here              ([deleteHere](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:deleteHere))
     gives the text now shown, typed or map   ([shownText](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:shownText))

[changed](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:changed)
says if a text differs from the map          

[baseFor](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:baseFor)
gives the text the map of any file holds for one place

[waiting](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:waiting)
says which files hold a writing not saved    

[markSoon](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:markSoon)
puts the dots as soon as the tree stands

[markWaiting](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:markWaiting)
puts a dot on those rows of the tree

     lists every place the file takes writing         ([slots](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:slots))
     marks what still waits for claude          ([queuedMark](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:queuedMark))
     says which place holds the box           ([isEditing](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:isEditing))
     numbers the lines of a text              ([numbered](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:numbered))
     numbers the lines of the writing box     ([gutter](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:gutter))
     draws the writing box                      ([editorHtml](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:editorHtml))
     draws the telling of a whole file    ([mapSlotHtml](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:mapSlotHtml))
     draws the place for your own words  ([expandSlotHtml](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:expandSlotHtml))
     numbers the lines of the code      ([codeSlotHtml](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:codeSlotHtml))
     
[fit](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:fit)
makes the box as tall as its text and its sideways bar without moving the page

     puts the caret in the new box without moving the page        ([focusEditor](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:focusEditor))
     holds what you typed while the page redraws     ([keep](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:keep))
     takes the words out of the open box          ([keepBox](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:keepBox))
     finds the letter you clicked                 ([caretAt](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:caretAt))
     finds that letter in the raw text        ([rawOffset](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:rawOffset))
     sends one ask to the server                        ([post](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:post))
     shuts the little menu                      ([menuClose](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:menuClose))
     finds a file by the name the server knows it by  ([fileNamed](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:fileNamed))
     lights the words a pin points at         ([flashAnchor](compiler/cli/human/reader/web.html:flashAnchor))
